title: Specification document
description: Implementation-tier (I) registry document (doc 11 §6), one per work package, canonical file `spec-NNNN.yaml`. Carries the Spec envelope (02 §2): the single binding between a work package and the contract it implements, plus the template and tests the build runs against and the gate that admits its evidence. Extends the common envelope (doc 11 §4) and constrains it to the specification type. Wholly structured (no narrative `sections`); the validator projects the YAML to {meta, data} and validates the projection. Each specification cites exactly one work package and exactly one contract (doc 11 §7 T4).

id.description: Document identifier of the form spec-NNNN, e.g. spec-0012 (doc 11 §3). A specification is a multi-instance document (one per work package); NNNN is a zero-padded four-digit ordinal, never reused or renumbered once assigned.

type.description: Document type discriminator; fixed to `specification` so the validator selects this schema.

data.description: The Spec envelope (02 §2): a single object (not a catalogue) binding this specification to its work package and contract, the template and tests the build runs against, and the gate that admits its evidence.

work_package.description: The single work package this specification realizes, of the form WP-NNNN (doc 11 §3). Exactly one; the join key back to the implementation-plan package whose scope and file leases this specification builds against (doc 11 §7 T4).

contract.description: The single service contract this specification implements, of the form CTR-NNNN (doc 11 §3). Exactly one; cites the frozen contract in service-contracts whose definition the build satisfies (doc 11 §7 T4).

template_reference.description: A `path://` reference to the template (skeleton/scaffold) the build authors against, e.g. `path://templates/connect-service/v1`. Points at the source of truth; the specification does not inline the template.

tests_reference.description: A `path://` reference to the test suite that verifies this specification, e.g. `path://internal/billing/billing_test.go`. The tests are the executable acceptance surface; their run produces the Evidence that the gate admits (doc 11 §7 T6).

gate.description: The gate that admits this specification's evidence: the human policy required to advance, the evidence kinds that must be present, and the numeric thresholds those kinds must meet (doc 11 §8).
Gate configuration for this specification (02 §2): how the status transition is admitted and what evidence it requires.

policy.description: Gate policy (doc 11 §8, 04 §5 policy table). `auto` = no human action once evidence is green; `approve` = a human must approve the green report before advancing; `edit` = the document is amendable in place before approval.

evidence_required.description: The evidence kinds that must be present and green before this gate admits the specification. At least one; each entry names an evidence producer the pipeline emits, e.g. `go-test`, `mutation-score`, `lint`. Each named kind should have a corresponding threshold where a numeric bar applies.

items.description: An evidence kind identifier, e.g. `go-test` or `mutation-score`.

thresholds.description: Numeric bars keyed by evidence kind that the evidence must meet to pass the gate, e.g. `{ "mutation-score": 0.8, "coverage": 0.9 }`. Keys correspond to `evidence_required` entries; values are the minimum acceptable measurement for that kind. May be empty when no evidence kind carries a numeric bar.

additionalProperties.description: The minimum acceptable numeric measurement for the keyed evidence kind.
